title: Jacob's ladders, point of contact of the remainder in the prime-number law with the Fermat-Wiles theorem and multiplicative puzzles on some sets of integrals
summary: In this paper we prove, on the Riemann hypothesis, the existence of such increments of the Ingham integral (1932) that generate new functionals together with corresponding new $Pζ$-equivalents of the Fermat-Wiles theorem. We obtain also new results in this direction.
